name: Tidekin
description: Tidekin are descended from water elementals. They are humanoids whose bodies are a combination of flesh and water.

features.name: Amphibious
features.description: You can breathe and move naturally underwater.

features.name: Lifespring
features.description: Once per rest, when you have access to a small amount of water, you can mark 2 Stress to heal a Hit Point on yourself or an ally.
